name: Prospective evaluation 1 (P1)
store: live mode only; replay stores and the 8 November 2026 pilot store are never pooled with P1
counted_forecast: for each match and model, the first stored forecast, if issued at least 0:30:00 before the scheduled start known when issued; sensitivity: the last forecast before the start
code_rule: a forecast counts only if its code_sha256 equals this protocol's; a code change during the window needs a committed amendment that lists the changed files and states that features, models and eligibility are unchanged, else forecasts from the changed code are reported separately
counted_matches: settled with no conflicting source reports; status completed (retirements, walkovers, defaults and cancellations excluded and counted); best of 3 or 5

primary.A: tournament-start model (phase4-ts-v1): log loss on all counted matches, ATP and WTA separately and combined, with week-clustered standard errors
primary.B: round-aware R0 (phase4-r0-v1) minus tournament start on the identical later-round matches where both were counted: paired log-loss difference, week-clustered 95% interval and a week-level cluster bootstrap (2,000 draws, seed 20261108)

secondary: uncalibrated surface Elo on the same matches (descriptive benchmark)

slices.level: Grand Slam; Masters / WTA 1000; tour finals; team events; other tour level
slices.best_rank_band: better-ranked player top 20, 21-100, over 100, both unranked
slices.identity: both verified, or a new player involved

clusters: the Monday of the week the edition starts; both tours together, because the same week shares conditions and data feeds. Sensitivity: clusters by edition
reporting_rule: a difference is called an improvement only if its 95% interval excludes zero; slices are descriptive; no slice result is called a finding
expected_size: at most about 3,000 rated tournament-start matches and 1,500 later-round pairs (the November-June calendar; June-October 2026 had 2,453 and 1,275), and only if fresh fixtures are ingested at least daily; fewer if snapshots are less frequent. With 1,500 pairs the standard error of the R0 gap is about 0.0025 (Phase 4 validation 0.0011 on 7,829 rows, scaled), so the smallest gain detectable with 80% power is about 0.007, against Phase 4's 0.0054-0.0072: P1 alone may well be inconclusive for R0, and that will be said

reference_values.note: Phase 4 erratum 1, June-October 2026; descriptive comparison only

decisions_forbidden: no model, feature, eligibility rule, threshold or calibration may be chosen from P1 outcomes while P1 is described as untouched. A model changed in response to P1 is a new version, evaluated on a later window that starts after its own freeze
monitoring: the monitor may be run at any time; its output is labelled interim, and it can trigger only an operational fix (data, identity, ingestion), never a model change inside P1
markets: not part of P1. Market prices, if collected, are stored with their own collection timestamps and evaluated under a separate protocol
